detail.longDescription:
Frenzy is the free social app ONLY for your BFFs.

Share pics, create your digital scrapbook, raise virtual pets, play daily games and much more.

No followers. No algorithm. No strangers. Just your bffs.

SHARE REAL MOMENTS
- Share moments with friends-only snaps and a friends-only feed
- Capture unfiltered moments

DAILY CHECK-INS WITH FRIENDS
- Raise a virtual pet with your BFF
- Track how much water you drink with friends
- Daily fit check in your private group

DIGITAL SCRAPBOOK
- Create a digital scrapbook with friends
- Add cut-outs, photos, stickers, stamps, and customize everything
- Track your calendar to journal every day

STYLE ADVICE FOR YOUR BFFS
- See your compatibility rating with your friends and crushes
- Get hairstyle and fashion advice for you and your friends
- Visualise who your celebrity lookalike is

SAFE & SECURE
- No strangers. Frenzy is for friends, not followers
- Block & report anything that makes you feel uncomfortable
- No doomscrolling, no ads, and no algorithm

AND MUCH MUCH MORE

Frenzy is exclusive to friends and invite-only
